title: Understanding Investment Diversification
content: Portfolio diversification is a risk management strategy that mixes a wide variety of investments within a portfolio. A diversified portfolio contains a mix of distinct asset types (such as stocks, fixed income, real estate, and gold) to limit exposure to any single asset or risk. The rationale is that a portfolio constructed of different kinds of investments will, on average, yield higher long-term returns and pose lower risk than any individual investment within the portfolio.
